title: Investigate the Qt PopupList contentWidth override diagnostic
source: Existing BACKLOG.md DEV-001 row; selected in all non-REL-001 work.
finding: The installed Qt Virtual Keyboard PopupList.qml redeclares ListView/Flickable contentWidth. Parsing that original SDK source in a standalone Qt qmltestrunner emits the exact warning without any QShopper imports.
reproduction: tests/upstream/tst_virtualkeyboard.qml; optional standalone Qt-only repro for the validated Windows 6.12.0 SDK. Explicit source loading reproduces; ordinary embedded compiled-module loading may be quiet.

verification.qt_only: out/remaining/qt-only-final.txt: four records pass and the direct original-source case emits the exact diagnostic. Generated isolated Debug runner independently gives the same result (out/remaining/qt-only-source.txt).
verification.application: out/remaining/keyboard-ctest.txt and out/windows-agent/tests/keyboard-tests.xml: production keyboard suite passes six records with real virtual-key/Return/composition, hide/reopen, zoom, drawer and Back controls; warning remains in the log.
verification.scope: Investigation only, no application fix or failing-before app regression claimed. Direct PopupList fixture uses an empty model and does not certify all language/candidate popup geometry or selection.

resolution.summary: Upstream-owned property-override diagnostic; no application change required. Complete the requested origin/impact investigation with independent reproduction and bounded passing behavior controls.
resolution.follow_up: Recheck the optional source probe and keyboard controls when upgrading Qt. No external upstream issue was filed.
